items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: I worked with Sidney Desweeney about two years.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well after you left Buddy Petite, did you go right away to Kid Renee's band? No, no, no.
After I left Buddy Petite, I worked with Sidney Desweeney. I see. Yeah. I worked with Sidney Desweeney about two years.
And who was in the band at that time with you?
